CustomField.description: Emits the Adobe Sign signer-fillable PO text tag ONLY when the quote has no PO number. Since 2026-08-22 the field is REQUIRED and shown only when the signer answers Yes to the PO-required question (showif). When the Account is flagged PO Required (credit control, ~270 accounts) the field is unconditionally required with no showif. When PO_Number__c is filled, the document prints the value as plain text instead and this field is blank.
CustomField.label: Order Form PO Tag
